title: possibly-used-before-assignment: 'aggregates' may be undefined at line 377
detail: The variable `aggregates` is only assigned inside a `if network_id:` block. If `network_id` is falsy (e.g., no routed-network request), the variable is never assigned, and the `if aggregates:` check at line 377 raises NameError. Initialise `aggregates = None` (or `[]`) before the conditional block.

title: 8 filter callback functions have unused interface arguments
detail: Eight filter functions at lines 173, 204, 248, 264, 280 (and others) declare `context` or `spec` parameters that are not used in their bodies. These are part of the filter callback interface. Prefix unused parameters with `_` to make the intent explicit.
